limitations: Disposable PGlite PostgreSQL/WASM fixtures with synthetic accounts, listings and provider metadata.
SOURCE/WEB and cleanup state transitions use retained SQL RPCs; metadata witnesses are synthetic and do not prove live Storage IO.
Competing CAS requests execute serially in the fixture; native concurrent PostgreSQL lock scheduling is not tested.
No Mac installation, remote database mutation, Git push or Vercel deployment is established by these results.

scenarios.purpose: One verified photo attaches once, preserves primary and original publisher; lost reply recovers exact receipt; SOURCE cleanup releases only child SOURCE reservation.
Two prepared additions at one revision serialize; stale second append fails CAS without losing its ready photo; explicit current revision succeeds.
Ten active photos block preparation; retirement permits ordinals10 and11 with immutable independent media URLs and current primary preserved.
Two prepared attempts for the last active slot cannot both attach, including a refreshed-revision second append.
Zero-image original publication receives its first child as ordinal0 and primary.
Retired child WEB is no longer served; exact cleanup releases its reservation; old append ACK survives retirement and whole parent deletion without resurrection.
The unchanged user path performs initial prepare, SOURCE/WEB completion and verification, confirmation and original publication through the shared allocator.
No-child gallery, primary/removal responses and root cleanup tasks preserve exact old schema1; no-child multipart remains schema3.
Ready child cannot enter ordinary confirmation/publish; an unrelated actor gets ownership refusal before child-purpose disclosure.
Durable existing request tombstone blocks a delayed preparation without creating a child or reserving bytes.
Cancellation closes an uncertain multipart dispatch while retaining exact cleanup lineage and quota; published parent SOURCE count excludes unattached children.
Whole deletion closes attached, ready and uncertain children atomically; all ten objects remain accounted for and no later dispatch/attach can revive content.
Another active business member may append and clean SOURCE; parent publisher remains unchanged; revoked member loses access.
Bound actor, current identity, RPC roles, protected binding relation and immutable metadata reject unauthorized writes/reads.
Ready acknowledgement alone cannot attach when exact Storage object metadata is absent or an upload witness remains unresolved.
An initially expired synthetic child cannot append or dispatch; cancellation retains its object lineage and reservations.
Twenty-one retained objects across one root and nine cancelled children remain accurately counted while a cleanup response carries at most twenty exact origins.
